name: RSI&Martingale1.5
summary: This EA uses RSI indicator signals for trade entry and applies a Martingale position-sizing strategy, doubling the lot size after each losing trade to recover losses. It opens buy positions when RSI is oversold and sell positions when RSI is overbought, then escalates lot sizes on consecutive losses. The strategy aims to recoup accumulated losses with a single winning trade but carries exponential risk exposure.
summary_zh: 该EA使用RSI指标信号进行入场交易，并采用马丁格尔仓位管理策略，在每次亏损后加倍手数以试图挽回损失。当RSI超卖时开多仓，RSI超买时开空仓，连续亏损时逐步加仓。该策略试图通过一次盈利交易收回累计亏损，但承受指数级风险暴露。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于RSI指标的超买超卖信号进行反向交易，属于均值回归与马丁格尔的组合策略。入场条件为：当RSI低于设定的超卖阈值时买入，当RSI高于超买阈值时卖出。出场条件依赖于止盈目标，当累计盈利达到设定值时平仓。仓位管理采用经典马丁格尔方法，每次亏损后将下一笔交易的手数乘以倍数系数（通常为2倍），以期望一次盈利覆盖之前所有亏损。资金管理方面，该EA没有严格的账户风险限制，仅依赖马丁格尔的数学期望来回收亏损，这在连续亏损情况下会导致手数呈指数增长。整体而言，该策略在短期可能表现稳定，但长期存在账户爆仓的极高风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy combines RSI overbought/oversold signals for counter-trend entries with a Martingale position-sizing system. Entry conditions trigger buy orders when RSI drops below the oversold threshold and sell orders when RSI rises above the overbought threshold. Exit conditions rely on a take-profit target, closing positions when cumulative profit reaches a configured level. Position sizing follows the classic Martingale approach, multiplying the lot size by a factor (typically 2x) after each losing trade, expecting a single win to recover all accumulated losses. Money management lacks strict account-level risk limits, relying solely on the Martingale mathematical expectation to recoup losses, which causes lot sizes to grow exponentially during consecutive losing streaks. Overall, the strategy may appear stable in the short term but carries extreme risk of account blowout over the long term.

pros: RSI是成熟且广泛使用的技术指标，超买超卖逻辑有一定统计依据
马丁格尔策略在短期内能快速回收小额亏损，回撤后恢复能力强
参数化设计允许用户调整RSI周期和马丁格尔倍数，灵活性较好
代码结构相对简单，便于理解和二次开发
pros_en: RSI is a well-established and widely used technical indicator with statistical basis for overbought/oversold levels
Martingale strategy can quickly recover small losses in the short term with strong recovery ability after drawdowns
Parameterized design allows users to adjust RSI period and Martingale multiplier for flexibility
Relatively simple code structure makes it easy to understand and modify for further development
cons: 马丁格尔策略在连续亏损时手数指数增长，存在账户爆仓的极高风险
缺少止损机制，单笔交易亏损无上限，依赖账户余额作为隐性止损
RSI在强趋势市场中会持续发出错误信号，导致连续加仓亏损
没有考虑交易成本（点差、佣金、隔夜费）对马丁格尔回收能力的影响
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
cons_en: Martingale lot sizing grows exponentially during consecutive losses, creating extreme account blowout risk
Lack of stop-loss mechanism means unlimited per-trade loss exposure, relying on account balance as implicit stop
RSI generates persistent false signals in strong trending markets, leading to consecutive losing positions
Trading costs (spread, commission, swap) are not factored into Martingale recovery calculations, reducing actual recovery probability
No new bar check mechanism may cause repeated position opening on the same candle
improvements: 增加严格的止损机制和最大连续加仓次数限制，防止手数无限增长
加入趋势过滤器（如均线方向），在强趋势中避免逆势开仓
增加点差过滤和新K线检查，提高入场质量和防止重复开仓
考虑加入账户风险百分比限制，当回撤超过阈值时停止交易
improvements_en: Add strict stop-loss mechanism and maximum consecutive Martingale step limit to prevent unlimited lot size growth
Incorporate a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction) to avoid counter-trend entries during strong trends
Add spread filter and new bar check to improve entry quality and prevent duplicate position openings
Consider adding account risk percentage limit to halt trading when drawdown exceeds a threshold

risk_points: 马丁格尔策略在连续亏损时手数指数增长，极大概率导致账户爆仓
缺少止损机制，单笔亏损无上限
无账户风险限制，可能在极端行情中损失全部资金
RSI逆势交易在趋势行情中会连续触发错误信号导致持续加仓
risk_points_en: Martingale lot sizing grows exponentially during losing streaks, extremely likely to cause account blowout
No stop-loss mechanism means unlimited per-trade loss exposure
No account-level risk limits, potential total capital loss in extreme market conditions
RSI counter-trend trading triggers consecutive false signals during trending markets, causing persistent position scaling
